mediaGuidelines.limitedRule: Every asset must be safe for work and non-suggestive, including inside the game.
mediaGuidelines.limitlessPublicRule: Covers and previews: no nudity, sexual acts, or graphic gore. Cover intimate areas with opaque clothing.
mediaGuidelines.limitlessAssetsRule: Permitted adult media stays inside age-restricted games. Keep covers and public previews non-explicit.
mediaGuidelines.profileSafe: Keep avatars and banners safe for work and non-suggestive.
mediaGuidelines.profileExplicit: No nudity, sexual acts, or graphic gore, even if your worlds are Limitless.
mediaGuidelines.blurRule: Blur and censor bars are not exceptions.

backgroundCharges.body: These AIs work in the background to keep your story on track, and they cost mushies each time they run. Nothing has been charged yet. Choose what they should do.
